connector.name: Kiln
connector.registryDescription: Kiln MCP server for agents: design, slice, print, monitor, and recover physical objects safely.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package kiln3d. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the codeofaxel account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KILN_PRINTER_API_KEY

env.name: KILN_PRINTER_TYPE
env.description: Printer type: octoprint, moonraker, creality, bambu, prusalink, elegoo, or serial
